author: Ari Koslow
title: Robert Suarez (forearm) might be available Wednesday
desc: The Braves say Robert Suarez might be available out of the bullpen on Wednesday.
impact: Suarez is dealing with a sore forearm. He is a game-time decision heading into Wednesday's game.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (hand) not in lineup Wednesday
desc: Zack Gelof is out of the lineup for Wednesday's game against the Giants.
impact: Gelof had X-rays return negative on his hand injury from Tuesday's game. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Flaherty (leg) on track to return Sunday
desc: Jack Flaherty is likely to be activated from the injured list to start against the Astros on Sunday.
impact: Flaherty is on track to return after missing the minimum number of days on the injured list.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Mick Abel to undergo arthroscopic right elbow surgery
desc: Mick Abel is set to undergo arthroscopic right elbow surgery, and his timetable for return will be determined after the surgery.
impact: Abel received a second opinion on his elbow injury, and it was decided that he will need to undergo surgery. The right-hander has dealt with injuries to his right elbow all season, pitching to a 3.98 ERA in just 20 1/3 innings this season at the MLB level.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Altuve racks up three hits in win over Blue Jays
desc: Jose Altuve went 3-for-6 in a win over the Blue Jays with one double and three runs scored.
impact: Altuve continues a productive stretch at the plate, recording hits in seven of his last 10 contests. The veteran continues to fight inconsistency at the plate for manager Joe Espada, batting .243 with eight home runs, 21 RBI, 36 runs scored, and one stolen base across 58 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Yainer Diaz goes deep as Astros outslug Blue Jays
desc: Yainer Diaz went 2-for-4 in Tuesday's 9-7 win over the Blue Jays with a solo home run.
impact: Diaz has been impactful in his return to the lineup, getting on base in each of his last five contests. The veteran remains another streaky option in the Astros lineup for manager Joe Espada, batting .246 with three homers, 16 RBI, and nine runs scored across 31 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tristan Beck optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Giants optioned Tristan Beck to Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Beck will return to Triple-A to make room for the return of Wednesday's starter Tyler Mahle from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Mahle (hamstring) activated from IL
desc: The Giants activated Tyler Mahle from the injured list.
impact: Mahle is officially set to return on Wednesday against the Athletics. He had been on the injured list since the end of May with a left hamstring strain.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cam Smith goes deep in win over Blue Jays
desc: Cam Smith went 2-for-5 in a win over the Blue Jays with a two-run home run.
impact: Smith has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in eight of his last 11 contests. The outfielder remains another streaky option in the Astros lineup for manager Joe Espada, slashing .223 with eight home runs, 28 RBI, 31 runs scored, and eight stolen bases across 79 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Taylor Trammell goes yard in win over Blue Jays
desc: Taylor Trammell went 1-for-3 in a win over the Blue Jays with a solo home run.
impact: Trammell continues a underwhelming stretch at the plate, collecting hits in two of his last 11 contests. The outfielder  offers manager Joe Espada another streaky bat in the Astros lineup, batting .275 with one home run, eight RBI, 10 runs scored, and one stolen base across 31 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Joey Loperfido goes deep in win over Blue Jays
desc: Joey Loperfido went 1-for-1 in a win over the Blue Jays with a grand slam.
impact: Looerfido has struggled at the plate of late, picking up hits in four of his last 12 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more underwhelming bats when in the Astros lineup, slashing .238 with one home run, 11 RBI, 12 runs scored, and one stolen base across 32 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Glasnow (back) still not throwing
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Tyler Glasnow remains shut down from throwing.
impact: Glasnow remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Peter Lambert labors on mound against Blue Jays
desc: Peter Lambert allowed two earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out six over 4 2/3 innings in Tuesday's win over the Blue Jays.
impact: Lambert continues a solid stretch on the mound, allowing less than three earned runs in each of his last five trips to the mound. The right-hander offers manager Joe Espada one of the more stable options as part of an underperforming Astros rotation, posting a 3.28 ERA and 1.17 WHIP with a 6-4 record and 8.9 K/9 ratio through 12 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker (back) to resume swinging Wednesday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Kyle Tucker will swing on Wednesday.
impact: If all goes well, Tucker is expected to be back in Friday's lineup against the Padres. He remains day-to-day for now.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. goes yard in win over Tigers
desc: Jazz Chisholm Jr. went 2-for-4 in Tuesday's win over the Tigers with a home run, two runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Chisholm Jr. continues an impactful stretch, getting on base in 13 of his last 15 contests. The second baseman continues to flash his power stroke as one of the more streaky bats in the Yankees lineup, slashing .230 with 12 homers, 33 RBI, 41 runs, and 23 steals across 75 games this season.
